Since Erin is smart and not blue (fact 6), by rule 1 ("If something is smart and not blue then it is not cold"), Erin is not cold. Applying rule 9 ("If something is furry and not cold then it is green"), Erin is green. The statement "Erin is not green" is contradicted by this derivation. 

ANSWER: False
